Hi, we are [team name]. Our project is ClauseGuard. It reads the fine print for you, and catches unfair clauses and scams before you sign or pay.

The problem

Nobody reads the fine print. Scammers count on it.

Red flag

PG agreement · clause 7

"…leave before 11 months for any reason, 100% of the ₹35,000 deposit shall be forfeited."

Scam

WhatsApp · incoming

"A DIGITAL ARREST WARRANT has been issued… transfer ₹24,500 via UPI."

Red flag

App terms · section 4.2

"Free trial renews at ₹4,999/year. Cancel only by notarized letter."

Red flag

Internship bond · clause 1–2

"Submit original 10th & 12th marksheets for 24 months."

These are real kinds of traps. A PG that keeps your whole deposit. A fake digital arrest scam. A free trial you can't cancel. A bond that keeps a student's original marksheets. They are written so nobody notices.

ONE SENTENCE IN A PG AGREEMENT

₹35,000

gone, for leaving one month early.

Forfeited
That one sentence can cost a student thirty-five thousand rupees. Most people only find out when they move out.

The gap

A chatbot gives a summary. You need a warning.

GENERIC AI CHAT

"This agreement outlines the terms between the tenant and owner, including the security deposit, lock-in period, maintenance charges and general conditions of stay…"

  • No exact sentence
  • No risk score
  • No reply to send

CLAUSEGUARD

"100% of the security deposit shall be forfeited automatically."

  • The exact trap, in plain English
  • 0–100 Safety Score
  • 1-click pushback reply
Caught
You can paste a contract into a chatbot, but you get a long summary. ClauseGuard points at the exact dangerous sentence, explains it simply, scores it, and writes your reply.

4 protection modules

One lens for every kind of trap

01 · LEASE

Rental & PG leases

Deposit forfeiture, unfair lock-ins, forced painting fees, 24-hour evictions.

02 · SCAMS

WhatsApp & cyber scams

Fake "digital arrest" warrants, UPI demands, malicious APK links.

03 · PRIVACY

App terms & dark patterns

Trap subscriptions, drip pricing, grabbing your contacts and photos.

04 · BONDS

Student & internship bonds

Original marksheets kept, refunds denied, ₹2 lakh exit bonds.

There are four modules: leases, scams, app terms, and student bonds. Each one knows the common tricks in that area.

Choose a model and a thinking level.

Not a lawyer: an early-warning tool that tells you when to push back or get legal help.

The website is HTML, Tailwind and JavaScript. A Python server runs the audit and the chat, and you can pick an AI model like Gemini. It's an early-warning tool, not a replacement for a lawyer.
